# Diagnostic codes

> **Audience:** deck authors, agents and contributors · **Generated from:** src/qa/codes.ts · **Version:** 0.7.6

`slidecraft check --json` and `build --json` report diagnostics with a stable `code`, a JSON `pointer` into deck.yaml, `measured` vs `limit` where relevant, and a `hint`. Exit codes: `0` ok (warnings allowed), `1` deck errors, `2` usage/internal error.

| Code | Severity | Meaning | Why | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SC-IMPORT-001` | error | Original PowerPoint object needs an editable equivalent | A source object or typography setting cannot yet be represented by the shared Scene importer. | Implement the corresponding editable primitive or source-font mapping before rebuilding; never drop the object or rasterise the slide. |
| `SC-HTML-002` | error | Required slide element missing from HTML | Serialized HTML did not preserve the shared slide frame contract. | Repair the HTML/SVG renderer. Titles, numbering, sources and visual frame elements must survive in every output. |
| `SC-CHROME-001` | error | Required slide chrome missing or duplicated | Titles, section labels, source lines, page numbers and theme decoration are part of the slide contract, not optional exporter embellishments. | Restore the shared frame or the required native object. Do not remove the requirement or rasterise the slide to make validation pass. |
| `SC-PPTX-003` | error | Editable object geometry or typography changed during export | The named PowerPoint shape no longer has the geometry or font size declared by the shared Scene. | Repair the renderer mapping; do not compensate by changing the reference sizes. |
| `SC-COVER-001` | warning | Cover without a visual | The cover is the first impression; the workflow chooses it from 2–3 options instead of leaving it plain. | Run `slidecraft covers <deck>` (add `--stock` with an `imageQuery`), compare the options and `--choose` one — or set `art:`, `image:` or `imagePrompt:` on the cover. |
| `SC-GHOST-001` | warning | Slide is still a ghost (a sketch, not a deliverable) | Ghost slides render as dashed placeholders with the planned exhibit; a deck with ghosts is not ready to hand over. | Write the slide content against the layout contract and remove `status: ghost` (on the slide and on the deck) and the `ghost:` block. |
| `SC-SPEC-001` | error | Deck does not match the schema | A field is missing, misspelled, has the wrong type or exceeds its declared capacity. | Read `slidecraft layouts --json` for the layout contract and correct the field at the pointer. |
| `SC-SPEC-002` | error | Unknown reference | A theme, storyline, layout, variant or source id does not exist. | Use an id from `slidecraft themes`, `slidecraft storylines`, `slidecraft layouts` or the deck `sources:` list. |
| `SC-SPEC-003` | error | Duplicate slide id | Slide ids must be unique so reviews and fixes can target one slide. | Give every slide a unique kebab-case `id`. |
| `SC-SPEC-004` | error | Included section file not found | A `- include: path.yaml` entry points to a missing or invalid file. | Check the path (relative to deck.yaml) and that the file contains a YAML list of slides. |
| `SC-FIT-001` | error | Text overflows its box | At the smallest allowed size the text still needs more lines than the box holds. SlideCraft never truncates. | Shorten the text by roughly the reported characters, split the point, or move detail to notes/backup. |
| `SC-FIT-002` | warning | Text shrunk below the preferred size | Copy-fitting stepped the font size down to make the text fit. | Optional: tighten the wording so the slide renders at the theme body size. |
| `SC-FIT-003` | error | Word too long for its box | A single word or token is wider than the column and would be split mid-word. | Hyphenate, abbreviate, or choose a layout with wider columns. |
| `SC-FIT-004` | error | Freeform HTML overflows its box | The content of a freeform slide is taller or wider than the slide body, so part of it would be cut off. | Shorten the text, reduce elements or sizes in the HTML/CSS, or split the slide. |
| `SC-FIT-005` | warning | Freeform text below the minimum size | Text in a freeform slide is smaller than the theme minimum and will be hard to read when presented. | Raise the font size in the CSS or cut text so it fits at a readable size. |
| `SC-HTML-001` | warning | Unsafe or external content removed from freeform HTML | Scripts, event handlers, frames and remote URLs are stripped so decks render offline, deterministically and without leaking data. | Use inline SVG, CSS and images next to the deck (relative paths) instead. |
| `SC-EDIT-001` | error | PPTX would contain a flattened picture | Freeform HTML needs a browser renderer and cannot be represented as separately editable PowerPoint objects. | Use native-canvas or another native layout. Set output.editablePptx: false only when a rasterised freeform slide is explicitly acceptable. |
| `SC-EDIT-002` | error | Freeform HTML cannot be reproduced as editable PowerPoint objects | The freeform block uses a CSS feature that has no equivalent in PowerPoint shapes and text boxes, so preserving both fidelity and editability would be misleading. | Use solid fills, borders, radii, text, flex or grid positioning; or opt in explicitly with output.editablePptx: false for a raster picture. |
| `SC-TITLE-001` | error | Action title runs past two lines | Titles are the argument of the deck; more than two lines stops them being skimmable. | Cut to one claim of ~8–14 words (under ~90 characters). |
| `SC-TITLE-002` | warning | Title reads like a topic, not a claim | Short noun phrases ("Market overview") state a subject but not the so-what. | Rewrite as a full sentence with a verb that states the takeaway (see action-title-writer skill). |
| `SC-TITLE-003` | warning | Title ends with punctuation | Consulting convention: action titles carry no trailing period. | Remove the trailing period. |
| `SC-SRC-001` | warning | Numbers without a source | The slide shows figures but cites no source. Every number must be traceable. | Add `sources: [id]` (from the deck `sources:` list) or a `source:` line. Mark illustrative data as such. |
| `SC-SRC-002` | error | Final deck has unsourced numbers | Decks with status `final` must cite every figure. | Add sources, or set status back to `review`. |
| `SC-GLYPH-001` | error | Font lacks glyphs for this text | The measuring font has no glyphs for some characters, so layout cannot be guaranteed. | Use a theme whose fonts cover the script, or set a `fonts.cyrillic` override in the theme. |
| `SC-GEOM-001` | error | Element outside the slide | A node extends beyond the page and would be clipped. | This is a layout bug — report it with the deck that triggers it. |
| `SC-GEOM-002` | warning | Content elements overlap | Two text or data elements intersect. | Reduce content so the layout can space it, or report a layout bug. |
| `SC-GEOM-003` | warning | Text spills out of its panel | Text starts inside a card, band or panel but its ink extends past the panel edge. | Shorten the text, reduce the number of items, or choose a layout with larger panels. |
| `SC-GEOM-004` | error | Text hidden under a shape | An opaque shape, picture, chart or table is drawn after the text and covers it, so the text is invisible. | Layout bug: draw backgrounds before the text they hold. |
| `SC-CONTRAST-001` | warning | Low text contrast | Text color against its background is below WCAG AA (4.5:1 body, 3:1 large). | Adjust the theme colors or the highlight choice. |
| `SC-DENSITY-001` | warning | Slide is dense | The slide carries more words than a reader can absorb in one pass. | Split into two slides or move detail into speaker notes. |
| `SC-STORY-001` | info | Storyline slot not covered | The chosen storyline expects a slide for this purpose and none was found. | Add the slide, or ignore if the slot does not apply to this deck. |
| `SC-PPTX-001` | error | Text missing from the PPTX | A string from the scene was not found in the written presentation XML. | This is an engine bug — report it with the deck that triggers it. |
| `SC-PPTX-002` | error | Slide element missing after export | A named chrome/bridge object, master text or speaker note did not survive the selected renderer. | Repair the engine mapping or provide an editable equivalent; do not remove the element from the reference to pass verification. |
| `SC-IMG-001` | warning | Image resolution too low | Effective resolution at its placed size is below 144 ppi; it will look soft when projected. | Supply a larger image or place it smaller. |
| `SC-IMG-002` | info | Image placeholder | An image slot has no image yet; a labelled placeholder was rendered. | Set `image: path/to/file.png` (relative to deck.yaml). |
| `SC-A11Y-001` | warning | Picture or chart without alt text | Screen readers announce nothing useful, and PowerPoint’s accessibility checker flags the slide. | Give images an `alt`; decorative images are marked decorative automatically. |
| `SC-A11Y-002` | warning | Slide title is not first in reading order | Screen readers read shapes in tree order; the title should come first so the slide is announced by its claim. | Rebuild with the bundled engine; SlideCraft moves the title to the front. |
| `SC-A11Y-003` | warning | Slide has no title placeholder | Without a title, the slide is unnamed in PowerPoint’s outline, navigation and screen readers. | Every SlideCraft layout writes its action title as the title placeholder; check custom post-processing. |
| `SC-DATA-001` | error | Data file or sheet not found | A fact, chart or table reads from a spreadsheet that is missing or has no such sheet. | Check `file` (relative to deck.yaml) and `sheet`; files are read again on every build. |
| `SC-DATA-002` | error | Data range does not fit the field | A `from:` reference is incomplete (no cell or range) or the cells are not what the field needs (e.g. text where a number is expected). | Point `range` at a block with a header row and numbers (charts), or `cell` at one value (facts). |
| `SC-DATA-003` | error | Unknown fact | Text uses {{id}} but the deck `facts:` has no such id. | Add the fact to `facts:` or correct the id. |
| `SC-CONSIST-001` | warning | The same number differs between slides | One metric appears with different values on different slides — the error a board notices first. | Use one value everywhere; define it once in `facts:` and write {{id}} in the text. |
| `SC-CONSIST-002` | warning | A total does not add up | A total row or column, a "Total" category or a waterfall total differs from the sum of its parts beyond rounding. | Correct the parts or the total; if the parts are a selection, say so ("Top 3", "Other" row). |
| `SC-CONSIST-003` | warning | One figure, different period or unit | The same metric shows the same number labelled with different years or currencies on different slides — one of the labels is wrong. | Use one period and one unit for the metric; define it once in `facts:`. |
| `SC-SRC-003` | error | Unknown source page reference | A slide cites `id#p12`, but the source id does not exist or the document has fewer pages. | Use an id from the deck `sources:` list and a page that exists — `slidecraft find` shows where a phrase is. |
| `SC-ENGINE-001` | warning | Engine unavailable, skipped | The requested engine is not installed or not detected on this machine. | Run `slidecraft doctor` for install hints, or choose another engine. |
